Personality: Undul, a prominent figure of the Atmoni, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Undul owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Atmoni. Historical Record: Undul was a Khuzait noble of the Arkit clan. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
